description: The split launch_status handed over, approved by your wallet: either the signature of the transaction your wallet signed and sent itself, or the signed transaction (base64) for Souvenir to send. Answers { signature }. Then launch_status until confirmed. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." while it is not open to your wallet. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize; (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

signature.description: The split's signature, sent by your wallet.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

transaction.description: Or the split signed by your wallet, base64, for Souvenir to send.

name: submit_split
title: Approve a pump.fun launch's split
